narrator.how: calmly, a little dry, with a quiet smile, unhurried — like the play's stage directions read aloud
narrator.name: narrator

busygin.how: young: quiet, restrained, a little hoarse from the cold; awkward when he lies
busygin.name: Volodya Busygin, a student

silva.how: brisk, merry, cheeky, quick; his anger in the same merry voice
silva.name: Silva, Semyon Sevostyanov

sarafanov.how: no longer young: soft, hurried, excited, short of breath and smiling; quiet when it hurts
sarafanov.name: Andrei Grigorievich Sarafanov, a musician

nina.how: even, direct, a little mocking and tired; never complaining
nina.name: Nina, Sarafanov's daughter

vasenka.how: a teenager's breaking voice: sullen, curt, hurt
vasenka.name: Vasenka, Sarafanov's son

kudimov.how: crisp, loud, by the regulations, unsmiling
kudimov.name: Mikhail Kudimov, a cadet

makarskaya.how: low, lazy, mocking; frightened when she shouts
makarskaya.name: Natalya Makarskaya, the neighbour

neighbor_m.how: from behind a window: sleepy, cross
neighbor_m.name: neighbour

neighbor_w.how: from behind a window: shrill, frightened and cross
neighbor_w.name: neighbour woman

neighbor_old.how: from behind a window: an old man, in a whisper, sly
neighbor_old.name: the old neighbour
